title: tests/userspace/test_af_alg.c: AF_ALG socket tests via kernel crypto API
description: Userspace test using Linux AF_ALG sockets to exercise wolfkm registrations via the standard kernel crypto API (not /dev/wolfcrypt). Tests: (1) skcipher: bind to 'cbc(aes)', set key, encrypt NIST vector, compare output; (2) hash: bind to 'sha256', hash NIST vector, compare digest; (3) aead: bind to 'gcm(aes)', encrypt with AAD. For each algorithm: also verify that /proc/crypto shows 'wolfkm' as the driver for that algorithm (confirms priority 300 override worked).
design: AF_ALG usage: socket(AF_ALG, SOCK_SEQPACKET, 0), bind with sockaddr_alg, setsockopt for key, accept, send/recv for data. Read /proc/crypto after bind to confirm wolfkm driver selected. This tests the kernel crypto API path (used by dm-crypt, IPsec) independently of /dev/wolfcrypt. See DESIGN.md §test_af_alg.
acceptance_criteria: AES-CBC via AF_ALG matches NIST vector. SHA-256 via AF_ALG matches FIPS vector. /proc/crypto confirms wolfkm driver. Test exits 0.
